name: Caetrum
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Caetrum and have them choose a player. Put the Caetrum to sleep. Put the Caetrum's *Dead* reminder token on the chosen player.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die, then a potion might break. Evil Potions that break might be received by another player instead.
flavor: Guaranteed to solve any minor problem by turning it into a major disaster.
